name: signature-pad
title: Signature Pad
description: A draw-to-sign pad for capturing handwritten signatures via pointer input.

props.name: defaultPaths
props.description:
The default paths of the signature pad.
Use when you don't need to control the paths of the signature pad.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the signature pad is disabled.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the signature pad elements. Useful for composition.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the signature pad. Useful for form submission.

props.name: paths
props.description: The controlled paths of the signature pad.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the signature pad is read-only.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the signature pad is required.

props.name: translations
props.description: The translations of the signature pad. Useful for internationalization.

events.name: onDraw
events.description:
Callback when the signature pad is drawing or the committed paths change.
`paths` contains only committed strokes; use `currentPath` for the in-progress stroke.

events.name: onDrawEnd
events.description: Callback when the signature pad is done drawing.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A signature pad with a clear trigger and a dashed signing guide.

examples.title: Form value
examples.description: Pass `name` to submit the committed strokes as JSON through a hidden input.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled pad ignores pointer input and skips the tab order.

examples.title: Controlled draw-end
examples.source:
import SignaturePad from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/signature-pad/signature-pad.marko";
{ paths = next; }/> committed strokes: ${paths.length}
examples.description: Listen for `drawEndChange` to read the committed stroke paths whenever a stroke is finished.
